raw_result.assessment: Required; earliest owner is implementation, not plan. The accepted contract says the separate Identity descriptor pins its intended database independently. Its connection rule requires descriptors to include database/endpoint identity and connected current_database() to match the selected descriptor. Merely selecting a named connection or storing a nonblank descriptor does not satisfy it. Current registration selects the explicit Identity connection but passes only its connection string to EF; IdentityCanonicalDatabaseIdentity is assigned/exposed without enforcement. Generator checker verifies data target, not separate Identity. Existing configuration, callable authentication interface and failure boundaries suffice; no new public verification interface or definition restart is needed. Covered by unfinished T018/T019 and qualification T020/T029. Identity DB access failure maps Unavailable/AuthorityUnavailable; data-target mismatch maps TargetUnavailable. Descriptor mismatch needs fail-closed rejection, not an invented requirement to label every mismatch AuthorityUnavailable. Read-only interpretation, no files/state changed.

next: Preserve accepted definition/approvals. After current diagnostic GREEN, test actual existing headless/host seam for mismatched Identity descriptor, then retained implementer minimal in-scope enforcement and final regression. No invented contracts or permissive test-only fallback.
